title: Release train weekly prep notes (May 20 2026)
body:
Meeting: Release Train — weekly prep (go/no-go)
Date: 2026-05-20 09:00 PT (prep notes)
Owner: Avery Brooks
Attendees (prep): Avery, Zara, Noah, Maya, Jordan, SRE on-call (Samir)
Objective: Quick sync to confirm readiness for milestone rollout (May 25 window). Identify blockers, owners, and clear go/no-go recommendation for Thu ops review.

AGENDA
- Quick status (5m)
- Checklist review by area (20m)
- Blockers & mitigation (10m)
- Canary plan + rollback (5m)
- Action items & owners (5m)

CHECKLIST (status = Ready / At-risk / Blocked)
1) Infra & Capacity
   - Dedicated GPU pool capacity validated for peak load (p95 estimate): Ready — Owner: Noah
   - Autoscaling policy tested in staging (burst to +30%): At-risk (tuning needed) — Owner: SRE (Samir)
   - Network egress rules and VPC peering for private deployments: Ready — Owner: Jordan

2) Serving runtime & model
   - Model artifact pinned: redwood-tabular-v2 @ v2.1.3 — Ready — Owner: Zara
   - Quantized variant smoke tests (int8) passed on 2/3 infra configs: At-risk — Owner: Applied ML (Maya)
   - KV cache warmup strategy documented and validated: Ready — Owner: Runtime team (PR merged)

3) Performance & reliability
   - Load test (15k qps sim) p95 latency: 240ms (below SLO 300ms): Ready — Owner: Performance (Noah)
   - End-to-end regression suite: All green except 1 flaky test (embed-regen): At-risk — Owner: QA (Zara)

4) Observability & alerts
   - Dashboards updated for release (latency/cost per-route): Ready — Owner: Observability (Jordan)
   - Alert thresholds verified and escalation path documented: Ready — Owner: SRE (Samir)

5) Security & compliance
   - KMS integration smoke test: Ready — Owner: Security (Priya)
   - Audit logs ingestion into SIEM: At-risk (CSV parser error in staging) — Owner: Security Ops (Priya)

6) Rollout & ops
   - Canary config (5% -> 25% -> 100%): Ready (playbook in runbook) — Owner: Release Eng (Avery)
   - Automatic fallback policy tested: Ready — Owner: Release Eng (Avery)

7) Customer comms & support
   - Post-release status page template prepared: Ready — Owner: Customer Success (Leah)
   - On-call rotation for release day staffed: Ready — Owner: SRE Manager

OUTSTANDING BLOCKERS (high priority)
- Autoscaling under burst shows slower than expected scale-up in one AZ — At-risk. Mitigation: bump min nodes + pre-warm; action owner Samir, due 2026-05-21 EOD. Linked ticket: REL-3478.
- Quantized variant failing on A100 node type in staging (OOM on long sequence): Blocked for int8 canary. Owner: Maya. Action: revert to fp16 for canary if not fixed by 2026-05-22 midday. Related PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-runtime/pull/512
- SIEM ingestion parser error for audit logs — At-risk. Owner: Priya. Action: hotfix in staging by 2026-05-21.

RISK ASSESSMENT
- Overall risk: Moderate. Key risk drivers: autoscaling burst behavior and quantized variant on A100. Both have mitigations that reduce blast radius (limited canary, fallback to fp16).

GO / NO-GO RECOMMENDATION (preliminary)
- Recommendation: GO for controlled canary (5% traffic) on May 25 with the following conditions (if these are not met -> NO-GO):
   1) Autoscaling tuning pushed and smoke tested in staging (Samir) — due 2026-05-21 EOD
   2) Quantized variant either fixed for A100 or fp16 canary fallback confirmed (Maya) — due 2026-05-22 12:00
   3) SIEM parser hotfix deployed to staging (Priya) — due 2026-05-21

CANARY & ROLLBACK PLAN (summary)
- Canary steps: 5% -> monitor 2h (latency, error, cost) -> 25% -> monitor 6h -> 100%
- Rollback triggers: p95 > 350ms for 15m, error rate > 1% sustained 5m, any security audit failure.
- Rollback action: immediate traffic shift to previous pinned model variant + alert channels (on-call + release channel).

ACTION ITEMS (owner / due)
- Samir: Autoscaling tuning + staging smoke test — due 2026-05-21 EOD (REL-3478).
- Maya: Fix quantized A100 OOM or confirm fp16 fallback for canary — due 2026-05-22 12:00 (PR referenced).
- Priya: SIEM parser hotfix deployed to staging + verify audit logs ingestion — due 2026-05-21.
- Noah: Final load test run with autoscaling changes (include AZ failover scenario) — due 2026-05-22.
- Zara: Triage flaky e2e test (embed-regen) and either fix or mark as flaky in runbook — due 2026-05-21.
- Avery: Draft ops announcement + runbook updates for Thu ops review — due 2026-05-21 12:00.

NOTES / TO-DO (personal scratch)
- Talk to infra about increasing warm pool during peak for first 2h of canary (quick win).
- Confirm Slack channel pinned messages + escalation contacts.
- Add small section in runbook about cost guardrails (abort canary if spend delta > 40% expected).

REFERENCES (quick links)
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/REL/May+2026+Release+Runbook
- Jira: REL-3421 (release plan), REL-3478 (autoscaling)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-runtime/pull/512

NEXT STEPS
- Run final readiness check Tue 2026-05-24 for ops go/no-go decision on Thu May 25 rollout window.
- If any of the three conditions above fail, call NO-GO and reschedule the rollout to next window (target Jun 1).

-- notes end --
